title: ManhattanGrid base class with grid snapping and linear movement
description:
Create the ManhattanGrid mobility class extending BaseMobility. Implement:
- Grid coordinate system with configurable spacing parameter
- snap_to_grid() method to align positions to nearest grid point
- Linear movement along grid lines (horizontal or vertical only)
- Speed parameter for movement rate
- Initial position placement on grid

Reference RandomWaypoint for base class pattern.
